title: Leaving the data-table formulas as they are fails the grader: they come out blank after its LibreOffice recalc, so the agent must hardcode 100 cells
evidence: The input has 100 data-table formulas: DCF V10:Z14, and Berk-Hath G10:K14, G18:K22 and G26:K30, e.g. '=TABLE($U$9,$C$10,$U12,$C$9,X$9)'. The golden file replaced every one with a hardcoded number (e.g. GT DCF V10 = 54647.44, Berk-Hath G26 = 11034.77). I applied exactly the golden file's five cross-sheet fixes to the input with openpyxl (DCF C10 → 'Exhibit 5'!C10; DCF G12/H12 → 'Exhibit 1'!B21/C21; Synergies D36 → WACC!$C$22; Merger Model C15 → 'Exhibit 6'!F33) and ran score_workbooks through managed_recalculated_xlsx(force_recalculation=True). Every TABLE cell came back None. Result: regression 0.9877 (below the 0.998 threshold), modification 0.7582, 100 cell errors (DCF 25, Berk-Hath 75), so the score is 0. The golden file itself scores 1.0/1.0 only because its tables are static numbers. To pass, an agent has to replace formulas with hardcodes. That contradicts the prompt, which lists 'hardcoded values that should be formulas' as an error to fix and says 'strictly avoid altering any cells that already contain values'. The difficulty comes from a tool limitation (LibreOffice doesn't re-evaluate Excel TABLE()), not from finance skill.
confirmation: The input has TABLE() formulas (e.g. DCF!V10 '=TABLE($U$9,$C$10,$U10,$C$9,V$9)') where the golden has static numbers. freeze_datatable_formulas (libreoffice.py:346) keeps only the cached value, which openpyxl drops on save, so the prompt's recommended openpyxl workflow leaves these
fix: All TABLE() grid cells, which come out blank or frozen after the grader's recalculation, are excluded from answer_position, so leaving them as formulas no longer fails.

title: Invalid golden solution and corrupted input data-table values in 'Berk-Hath Investment Package'!G10:K14 make 22 of 91 modification cells impossible to pass properly
evidence: The sole verifier `SpreadsheetBench 2 official cell check` (`verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells`, weight 1.0, binary pass/fail requiring `reg_ratio == 1.0` and `mod_ratio == 1.0`) includes `'Berk-Hath Investment Package'!B2:K44` in `answer_position`. Nothing on `'Berk-Hath Investment Package'` was intentionally altered for this cross-sheet-reference debugging task, nor does it have any cross-sheet reference errors (`C15 = 'Exhibit 9'!M25/100`, `C29 = 'Exhibit 5'!B10`, `C31 = 'Exhibit 6'!F32` match between input and golden). However, in `untouched_input_Incorrect Cross Sheet References_input.xlsx`, the 5x5 sensitivity table `'Berk-Hath Investment Package'!G10:K14` (varying Dividend Rate `F10:F14` = `7.0%, 7.5%, 8.0%, 8.5%, 9.0%` in `$C$12` against Discount Rate `G9:K9` = `6.3%, 6.8%, 7.3%, 7.8%, 8.3%` in `$C$15` for `F9 = C44`) was exported by LibreOffice 7.3.7.2 with `<f aca="true">TABLE($F$9,$C$12,$F10,$C$15,G$9)</f>` and the base-case value `11432.1670414077` written into all 25 cells. Meanwhile, `gt_02_golden.xlsx` stores hardcoded numbers in `G10:K14` produced by a self-mutating Excel 2D Data Table: because row header `F12` has the formula `=C12` (the table's own row input cell) and `F10:F11, F13:F14` chain off `F12` (`=F11-$F$7`, `=F12-$F$7`, `=F12+$F$7`, `=F13+$F$7`), Excel's sequential substitution of `C12` mutated the row headers during evaluation. Consequently, `gt_02_golden.xlsx` evaluates Row 11 (`F11=7.5%`) and Row 12 (`F12=8.0%`) both at a `6.5%` dividend rate (`[11152.88, 10782.64, 10429.31, 10092.03, 9769.95]` instead of the true 7.5% values `[11878.54, 11491.54, 11122.04, 10769.13, 10431.98]` and true 8.0% values `[12241.37, 11845.99, 11468.40, 11107.68, 10762.99]`), Row 13 (`F13=8.5%`) at a `7.0%` dividend rate (`[11515.71, 11137.09, 10775.67, 10430.58, 10100.97]`, identical to Row 10, instead of `[12604.20, 12200.43, 11814.76, 11446.24, 11094.00]`), and Row 14 (`F14=9.0%`) at an `8.0%` dividend rate (`[12241.37, 11845.99, 11468.40, 11107.68, 10762.99]` instead of `[12967.03, 12554.88, 12161.12, 11784.79, 11425.01]`). Because `untouched_input` has `11432.17` in `G10:K14` while `gt_02_golden.xlsx` has these self-mutated values, 22 of the 25 cells (`G11:G12, G14, H10:H14, I10:I13, J10:J14, K10:K14`) differ by more than 1% and are classified as required modification cells (22 of 91 total modification cells). Furthermore, `recalculate_xlsx` calls `freeze_datatable_formulas` before running LibreOffice: if an agent leaves `G10:K14` untouched (or recalculates via LibreOffice), `G10:K14` remains `11432.17` and fails all 22 modification cells (capping `mod_ratio` at `69/91 = 0.7582`, score `0.0`); if an agent saves via `openpyxl` (which drops cached `<v>` on formula cells), `freeze_datatable_formulas` strips `<f>TABLE(...)</f>` from all 100 `TABLE(...)` cells across `'DCF'!V10:Z14` and `'Berk-Hath Investment Package'!G10:K30`, leaving them `None`; and if an agent computes the mathematically correct sensitivity values for `G10:K14` (as Unit 3 did), 20 of the 25 cells (`G11:K14`, 18 modification cells and 2 regression cells) still fail against `gt_02_golden.xlsx` by 5.6%–9.2% (score `0.0`).
confirmation: Verified: the input G10:K14 cache is 11432.167 everywhere. The golden values come from a self-mutating data table (F12='=C12', with F10:F14 chained via $F$7), so they duplicate rows: column I is 10775.67/10429.31/10429.31/10775.67/11468.40. fix: The 22 Berk-Hath G10:K14 modification cells (corrupted golden values vs frozen 11432.17 input caches) are no longer graded, via the same answer_position change.

title: The answer key's Berk-Hath sensitivity table (rows 11-14) is wrong, so a correct agent cannot pass
evidence: This problem has one verifier, verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells (weight 1, pass/fail). It passes only if every modification cell matches the golden file. The table at 'Berk-Hath Investment Package'!G10:K14 is a two-way data table: rows F10:F14 are dividend rates 7.0/7.5/8.0/8.5/9.0%, columns G9:K9 are discount rates 6.3-8.3%, and the formula input is C44 (total package value = PV of dividends + PV of redemption + $736.33M warrant). I recomputed it with PV(r,10,d*10000)+PV(r,10,0,10500)+736.33. Row 10 (7%) in the GT is correct (11515.7, 11137.1, 10775.7, 10430.6, 10101.0). Rows 11-14 are not. They copy other rows: the GT has row 11 = row 12 = 11152.88/10782.64/10429.31/10092.03/9769.95, row 13 = row 10 (11515.71...), and row 14 = the term-10 row of the second table (12241.37...). The correct values are: 7.5% row 11878.5/11491.5/11122.0/10769.1/10432.0; 8.0% row 12241.4/11846.0/11468.4/11107.7/10763.0; 8.5% row 12604.2/12200.4/11814.8/11446.2/11094.0; 9.0% row 12967.0/12554.9/12161.1/11784.8/11425.0. The base case shows the error: GT I12 (8% dividend, 7.3% discount) = 10429.3, but the model's own C44 = 11432.2 at nearly the same inputs (C15 = 7.35%). The second table's matching cell I20 = 11468.4, which agrees with C44. The verifier marks 22 of these cells as 'modification' cells. An agent that computes the table correctly misses most of them, and the pass/fail score is then 0.
confirmation: GT I12 (8% dividend, 7.3% discount) is 10429.31, while the model's own I20 for the same scenario is 11468.40 and C44 is 11432.17. Rows 11-14 of the golden table are wrong copies of other rows, so a correct sensitivity table fails.
fix: The wrong golden Berk-Hath rows 11-14 are no longer compared (answer_position excludes G10:K14), so a correct sensitivity table is not penalised.

title: Golden sensitivity-table values contradict the model and reject correct calculations
evidence: In gt_02_golden.xlsx, 'Berk-Hath Investment Package'!I12 is 10429.3142071995 for an 8% dividend rate, 7.3% discount rate and 10-year redemption term. The same scenario in I20 is 11468.3953341322. Independently calculating the preferred dividends, redemption payment and warrant value confirms 11468.3953341322. Twenty cells in G11:K14 contain incorrect expected values, with errors of approximately 6–9%. Testing the golden workbook with only this sensitivity table mathematically corrected, including the verifier's required recalculation, produces modification ratio 0.8022 rather than 1.0. Consequently, the sole verifier, weighted 100%, awards zero for correcting these errors despite the instruction to 'audit and fix this file thoroughly.'
confirmation: Confirmed: GT 'Berk-Hath Investment Package'!I12=10429.3142 vs I20=11468.3953 for the identical scenario. The golden's G11:K14 values are wrong, so a mathematically correct table is scored as a modification error.
fix: Same answer_position change: the contradictory golden sensitivity values are no longer graded.

title: SpreadsheetBench 2 official cell check: verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells produces false negatives (score 0.0 on all units) due to corrupted sensitivity table values in gt_02_golden.xlsx vs untouched_input
evidence: Across all 3 units, `SpreadsheetBench 2 official cell check` (`verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells`, weight 1.0) scored `0.0`: Unit 1 (`regression 1.0000, modification 0.6923, 35 cell errors`), Unit 2 (`regression 1.0000, modification 0.1319, 86 cell errors`), and Unit 3 (`regression 1.0000, modification 0.4505, 60 cell errors`). Independent reconstruction from the trajectories shows two distinct verifier/ground-truth defects causing false negatives: (1) In Unit 1, the agent identified and fixed all 5 intended cross-sheet reference errors (`DCF!C10 = +'Exhibit 5'!C10`, `DCF!G12 = 'Exhibit 1'!B21+'Exhibit 1'!B14+'Exhibit 1'!B17`, `DCF!H12 = 'Exhibit 1'!C21+'Exhibit 1'!C14+'Exhibit 1'!C17`, `Synergies!D36 = WACC!$C$22`, `Merger Model!C15 = +'Exhibit 6'!F33`), matching 100% of modification cells on `DCF` (17/17) and `Synergies` (11/11). However, 22 of Unit 1's 28 modification errors came from `'Berk-Hath Investment Package'!G10:K14`, where `untouched_input` has `11432.1670414077` (written by LibreOffice's buggy `TABLE(...)` evaluation when the input file was created) and `gt_02_golden.xlsx` has corrupted self-mutating Excel Data Table values, while `recalculate_xlsx` freezes `TABLE(...)` cells to their cached values via `freeze_datatable_formulas` before running LibreOffice. (The remaining 6 modification errors and 7 regression errors in Unit 1 came from fixing genuine unfixed bugs in `gt_02_golden.xlsx`: `Merger Model!C31, C32, E31, C59, C60, E59`, `Synergies!Q11, Q12, Q17, Q19`, and `Exhibit 9!N23:P23`). (2) In Unit 3 (Step 92: "Plus 25 cached value corrections (Berk table)"), the agent explicitly recalculated and populated `'Berk-Hath Investment Package'!G10:K14` with the mathematically exact 2D sensitivity values (`C42 + PV(disc_rate, 10, -div_rate*10000, -10500)`), yet 20 of those 25 cells (`G11:K14`, comprising 18 modification cells and 2 regression cells) were still marked wrong by the verifier because `gt_02_golden.xlsx` stores values evaluated at mutated dividend rates (`6.5%, 6.5%, 7.0%, 8.0%` instead of `7.5%, 8.0%, 8.5%, 9.0%`). Even a synthetic probe that applies only the 5 exact golden formula fixes to `untouched_input` scores `0.0` (`modification 0.7582`, 22 errors in `'Berk-Hath Investment Package'!G10:K14`).
confirmation: In the input, 'Berk-Hath Investment Package'!G10:K14 are TABLE() cells all cached at 11432.167. The golden holds wrong static values, e.g. I12=10429.31 against I20=11468.40 for the same 8%/7.3%/10-yr case, and its I-column repeats rows (10775.67, 10429.31, 10429.31, 10775.67, 11468.40).
